test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: Load Welker Farms (savegame3). This ticks by itself.

test.title: Welker: ground a run on the floor
test.hint: Go to the floor just above the ground (the spot you name). Ground tool: pick a run on it, right-click. Ticks itself if the floor is seen.

test.title: Welker: drop a point on the floor
test.hint: Move tool: drag a point onto the floor and let go. Ticks itself if the floor is seen.

test.title: Welker: divide a run on the floor
test.hint: Divide tool: pick a run on the floor, right-click. Fly low beside it. All points sit on top of the floor, none under it. PASS if so.

test.title: Welker: bridges still work
test.hint: Ground tool: pick a run over a bridge, right-click. The points stay on the deck. SKIP if no bridge is near.

test.title: Welker: height slice over a shed
test.passLog: height slice: the mouse is on point id=
test.hint: Over a shed with points on its floor, press G. The roof goes. Hold the mouse on a floor point. Ticks by itself. G again.

test.title: Welker: spline loop joins both lane ends
test.hint: Spline tool. At a two-lane road end, click 1 m off one lane end, round a loop, 1 m off the other. Right-click. Ticks by itself. Q.

test.title: Welker: field loop on a Courseplay field
test.passLog: field loop boundary: Courseplay custom field
test.hint: Field loop tool, Courseplay field on. Click inside a Courseplay custom field. Ticks by itself. Q to undo.

test.title: Welker: fresh T at x -207, z -926
test.passLog: a new junction %(no number yet.*the mod's T fitted
test.hint: Junction tool, clear + build. Click the T at x -207, z -926 (card: junction: new). Right-click. Ticks by itself. Q to undo.

test.title: Welker: Smooth rebuild round the loop
test.hint: Smooth, rebuild. On a one-way loop click two points, then click on past the far end round the loop. Right-click. Only that stretch changes. Q.

test.title: Welker: Smooth card beside its help
test.hint: Hold Smooth, press / for help. The card moves beside the help, and no card text shows on the help page. PASS if so.

test.title: Welker: FlyoverResetInput keeps your controls
test.hint: Close the editor. In the console type FlyoverResetInput. Ticks by itself. Then walk or drive: FAIL if any key is dead.

test.title: Lehndorf: islands kept, the old loop
test.hint: Load Lehndorf. Field loop tool: margin -2, detect custom field off, leave out islands off. Click a field with tree patches. Ticks by itself.

test.title: Lehndorf: islands left out
test.hint: Press Q (undo). Turn leave out islands on. Click the same spot again. Ticks by itself.

test.title: Lehndorf: the loop runs round the field only
test.hint: The new loop follows the field edge and runs into no tree patch or pylon. PASS if so.

test.title: Lehndorf: the field with the lone pylon
test.hint: Find the field with one pylon patch in it. Click inside it. The loop goes round the whole field. PASS if so.

test.title: Any map: the wheel still zooms if it goes dead
test.hint: Nothing to do on purpose. If the editor wheel ever stops zooming, this ticks and the view zooms anyway. PASS if it did. SKIP if it never went dead. If it ticks, say whether you had just pressed the middle button.
